units: mm, g, deg (internal manifest joint convention: q = firmware_deg - 90 with manifest sign)

mass_model.status: provisional-nominal — weigh the real robot and parts (NEEDS-HARDWARE)
mass_model.servo_note: MG90S nominal from manifest/robot.yaml; SG90 is about 9 g
mass_model.battery_note: S3 build pack (B0F3JB59B6, 47 g listing) at the V3 kit's battery_mount envelope — NEEDS-HARDWARE
mass_model.pla_note: solid PLA is 1.24; small upstream parts with default walls/infill assumed ~77 %

walking_rom.note: union of walk / walk_backward / turn_left / turn_right / stand / rest in manifest/motions.yaml

shell.variant_note: v3-mushroom = support-free ogive dome (cap) on one printed stem+lid part (the kit head lid with a stem standing on it). The stem's two spring prongs pass through the dome's apex and their knob becomes the dome's tip (snap, squeeze to release); a fin through a keyway sets the rotation. No crown, no screws.

acceptance.max_other_rest_depth_note: 2026-11-11: non-belly rests that need < 0.2 mm of CoM rise to leave (vs ~14 mm belly) are accepted; they appear only with the +-3 mm CoM perturbation. MuJoCo drop/recovery stay the functional check.

body.note: Loftwork V3 frame kit adapted for the APS carrier (reference/frame-and-cover_261105). Legs unchanged, hip axes at the kit datums.

electronics.name: carrier-components
electronics.note: S3 SuperMini, PCA9685 hub, LM2596, OLED, plugs inside the head; mass estimated, box only for CoM/protection

body.pla_parts_note: head-lid is replaced by stem-lid (a shell part, mass from CAD)

extra_parts.name: stem-lid minus kit lid (quick_screen estimate only)

fit_check.note: overhang: downward-facing area whose slope from horizontal is below the part's limit (bed excluded); dome inner cap is 30 deg (print with <= 0.16 mm layers); stem-lid: the kit lid's rail lip (1.9 mm) and the knob's catch (1 mm) are the flat overhangs

stem.note: printed upright on the lid's underside (lid + stem one part); the dome prints rim-down on its own plate. A one-piece dome+stem+lid cannot print without supports: the dome needs its rim (z 34.5) on the bed and the lid (z 66-70) would hang in mid-air inside it.

fin.note: rotation key: the rib at phi rises through a keyway in the dome, flush with the outer surface

lighten.note: pockets in the lid's top face (open upwards when printed upright); cross ribs through the stem

key.note: separate stopper key: drops through a slot in the lid's rear so its tip sits in front of the head-cover rear panel's inner top edge (x = -36.2); y = +10 keeps it clear of the centred switch and the USB plug
